lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs are organized in roughly vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. A central grouping of four prominent, high-luminance spots in the mid-flank area forms a discernible trapezoidal arrangement.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal rows of white blobs, creating a discernible grid-like pattern across the mid and posterior sections of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant horizontal linear feature is visible across the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity pixels on the upper edge and distinct shadowing on the lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin, visible in the lower portion of the frame, exhibits a dense distribution of small circular spots that are significantly smaller in diameter than the primary lateral flank blobs.
